name: Ko Prey Village🍀[VC🔊]
desc:
🌿 Welcome to Ko Prey Village🌿
Step into a peaceful world full of trees, rivers, mountains, and open skies. 🌳☁️
This game is designed for chilling with friends, exploring the beauty of nature, and enjoying calm vibes.

✨ Features:

🌲Relaxing forests 
💧Waterfalls & rivers 
🔥Cozy campfire spots 
🪵Chill hangout areas 
📸Scenic photo spots 

🌸 Whether you want to chat, roleplay, or simply enjoy the sounds of nature, this hangout is the perfect place.
💚 Invite your friends and escape the busy world into a calm natural paradise!
